c1.text: Hey Devin. I have a two-player air hockey game called Glow Puck in my product-demo-apps repo, in the glow-puck folder. It's built with Expo, so one codebase runs on iOS, Android, and the web, and it has a live referee on GPT-Live-1 that the players can talk to.

c2.text: I want to add one feature. When a player says time out, the referee should call a new tool that pauses the match for ten seconds, shows a countdown on the table, and then resumes play by itself.

c3.text: Oh, and have the referee announce the time out when it starts, and call play back in when it ends.

c4.text: Test it on the web build in Chrome and on the iPhone simulator, with recordings of each, then open a pull request.

c6.text: Hey Devin, how's the time out feature coming along?

c7.text: Great. Let me know when the pull request is up.
